name: Super Tank
summary: Super Tank Simulator puts you in command of a tank across eight challenging combat zones viewed from above. Using rotational control and forward/reverse movement, you must navigate narrow and branching paths where exploration often determines survival. The sturdy walls can deflect enemy fire – a strategic advantage for attacking from cover. You'll face threats like gun turrets, enemy tanks, and landmines. Your standard weapon gets stronger the longer it's held, and you can also collect smart bombs and shields. Each top-down section is followed by a first-person view level where you control a crosshair to take out helicopters and jeeps.
